[[File:cyberdemon_sprite.png|thumb|Cyberdemon is a good example of Cybernetic monster.]]
Cybernetic monster also known as [[cyborg]] monster, are the monster that were half-organic and half-robot. There are two categories of Cybernetic monster: cybernetic former human and cybernetic demon.
